Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the boundary provision for Island county.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to Island county boundaries; and amending RCW36.04.150.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.04.150 and 1891 c 119 p 217 s 1 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Island county shall consist of all of the islands known as Whidbey,Camano, Smith(('s)), Deception, Strawberry, and Ben Ure(('s)) and shallextend into the adjacent channels to connect with the boundaries ofadjoining counties as defined by statute.
